items.name: Autodesk Flow Studio 3D Editor + Canvas

items.why_en: Autodesk Flow Studio released 3D Editor + Canvas this month, significantly enhancing AI rigging and animation control for more precise generative AI filmmaking.

items.name: Meshy-6 Auto-Rig + Animate
items.why: Meshy 於本月更新其 AI 自動綁骨與動畫生成工具的指南,強調其在數秒內將 3D 模型轉化為可動角色的能力,持續作為業界領先的解決方案。
items.why_en: Meshy updated its AI Auto Rigging and Animation Generator guide this month, highlighting its capability to transform 3D models into animatable characters in seconds, maintaining its position as a leading solution.

items.name: Tripo Auto-Rigging (Uni-Rig)
items.why: Tripo AI 於 6 月初更新其平台,將動畫綁骨模型版本升級至 v2.5-20260210,持續優化其自動綁骨功能。
items.why_en: Tripo AI updated its platform in early June, upgrading its animate rig model version to v2.5-20260210, continuously optimizing its auto-rigging capabilities.

items.name: Cascadeur 2026.1
items.why: Cascadeur 2026.1 於 4 月發佈,引入了 Filament 渲染引擎、Unreal Engine Live Link 及 AI 驅動的 Root Motion 工具,大幅提升動畫工作流程。
items.why_en: Cascadeur 2026.1 was released in April, introducing the Filament Rendering Engine, Unreal Engine Live Link, and an AI-powered Root Motion Tool, significantly enhancing animation workflows.

items.name: Anything World — Animate Anything
items.why: Anything World 的 Animate Anything 服務持續提供 AI 驅動的自動綁骨與動畫功能,其 Unity Asset Store 版本最新發佈於 2025 年 4 月。
items.why_en: Anything World's Animate Anything service continues to offer AI-driven auto-rigging and animation, with its Unity Asset Store version last updated in April 2025.
